decision.explanation: The cofactor C₃₄ is (-1)^(3+4) times the determinant obtained by deleting row 3 and column 4. This gives the negative determinant in option d.

after.name: Question 1
after.worked_solution:
First, to get the minor of ${b}_{34}$, we remove the $3$rd row and the $4$th column: 

$$
B=[\begin{aligned}-2 & 2 & 3 & ∗ \\ 1 & 3 & 0 & ∗ \\ ∗ & ∗ & ∗ & -2 \\ -7 & 0 & 0 & ∗\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{34}=|\begin{aligned}-2 & 2 & 3 \\ 1 & 3 & 0 \\ -7 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}|.
$$

Therefore, the cofactor of ${b}_{34}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{34} & =(-1)^{3+4}{M}_{34} \\  & =-{M}_{34} \\  & =-|\begin{aligned}-2 & 2 & 3 \\ 1 & 3 & 0 \\ -7 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

$$
G=[\begin{aligned}8 & ∗ & 2 & \sqrt{3} & -2 \\ 3 & ∗ & 0 & \sqrt{7} & 1 \\ 0 & ∗ & -5 & 6 & -4 \\ ∗ & \sqrt{5} & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ \\ 11 & ∗ & 0 & -9 & 11\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{42}=|\begin{aligned}8 & 2 & \sqrt{3} & -2 \\ 3 & 0 & \sqrt{7} & 1 \\ 0 & -5 & 6 & -4 \\ 11 & 0 & -9 & 11\end{aligned}|.
$$

Now, the cofactor of ${g}_{42}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{42} & =(-1)^{4+2}{M}_{42} \\  & ={M}_{42} \\  & =|\begin{aligned}8 & 2 & \sqrt{3} & -2 \\ 3 & 0 & \sqrt{7} & 1 \\ 0 & -5 & 6 & -4 \\ 11 & 0 & -9 & 11\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

$$
{M}_{35}=|\begin{aligned}3 & -8 & 2 & 1 \\ 3 & 5 & \sqrt{13} & 0 \\ 4 & 8 & 3 & 8 \\ 11 & 3 & \sqrt{2} & -9\end{aligned}|.
